example: The old iron gate at the entrance to the garden creaked loudly as she pushed it open.
exampleCn: 花园入口那扇旧铁门在她推开时发出了响亮的吱嘎声。

example: Our neighbour's big orange tom spends most afternoons napping in our sunny front garden.
exampleCn: 邻居家的大橘猫大多数下午都在我们家阳光明媚的前花园里打盹。

example: They condemned him without a hearing.
exampleCn: 他们未经听证就对他定罪。

example: We ate at a Japanese restaurant.
exampleCn: 我们在一家日式餐馆吃了饭。

example: The increasing cost worries us.
exampleCn: 不断上涨的费用让我们担忧。

example: Neither of the two candidates had the experience required for the senior management position.
exampleCn: 两位候选人都不具备高级管理职位所需的经验。

example: He has a cold in the nose.
exampleCn: 他鼻子感冒了。

example: She started working part-time at the bookshop when she was just fifteen years old.
exampleCn: 她十五岁时就开始在那家书店做兼职了。

example: They devote their lives to caring for the sick.
exampleCn: 他们将一生奉献给照顾病人。

example: The sharp pain in his tooth forced him to see a dentist after two sleepless nights.
exampleCn: 牙齿的剧痛让他在两个不眠之夜后不得不去看牙医。

example: The prince was prepared to become King one day.
exampleCn: 王子准备有一天成为国王。

example: Martin runs a small bakery on the corner of our street and makes the best croissants in town.
exampleCn: 马丁在我们街角开了一家小面包店做的可颂全城最好。

example: Bloody your hands.
exampleCn: 你的手沾满了血。

example: In the wake of the accident no one knew how many had been injured.
exampleCn: 事故发生后，没有人知道有多少人受伤。

example: We arrived at the airport three hours early to be on the safe side for the international flight.
exampleCn: 我们提前三小时到了机场为了国际航班保险起见。

example: We built the patio furniture ourselves instead of buying it from the expensive garden shop.
exampleCn: 我们自己动手做了露台家具而不是从昂贵的园艺店购买。

example: He spilled coffee all over his white shirt just minutes before the important job interview.
exampleCn: 就在重要的工作面试前几分钟他把咖啡全洒在了白衬衫上。

example: Green Valley Corp. grew quickly after launching its new software product.
exampleCn: Green Valley 公司推出新软件产品后迅速发展。

example: The picnic was her suggestion.
exampleCn: 野餐是她的建议。

example: The first snow of winter fell silently overnight, blanketing the whole town in white.
exampleCn: 冬天的第一场雪在夜里悄然而至，将整个小镇覆盖成白色。

example: We speak English in class.
exampleCn: 我们在课堂上说英语。

example: She decided to stop eating meat and has been a vegetarian for nearly three years now.
exampleCn: 她决定不再吃肉吃素已经快三年了。

example: Visual aids in teaching.
exampleCn: 教学中的视觉辅助。

example: The old man was born a Jew and remained deeply connected to his faith throughout his long life.
exampleCn: 这位老人出生就是犹太人在他漫长的一生中始终与自己的信仰保持着深厚的联系。

example: He practises basketball in the school gymnasium for two hours every evening after classes end.
exampleCn: 他每天放学后在学校体育馆练习两个小时的篮球。

example: All those in favour of the motion, please say aye so we can record the vote.
exampleCn: 所有赞成这项动议的人请说赞成，以便我们记录投票。

example: The two groups differed significantly.
exampleCn: 两组之间存在显著差异。

example: These are real problems that can be dealt with most effectively by rational discussion.
exampleCn: 这些都是现实问题，通过理性讨论可以最有效地解决。

example: The small wooden cabin by the lake has been our family's favourite summer retreat for decades.
exampleCn: 湖边那座小木屋几十年来一直是我们家最喜欢的夏日度假地。

example: The old pub on the corner serves the best fish and chips I have ever tasted.
exampleCn: 街角那家老酒馆的炸鱼薯条是我吃过最好吃的。

example: Everyone in the office attended the farewell party except Mark, who was away on a business trip.
exampleCn: 办公室里除了出差的马克以外，所有人都参加了欢送会。

exampleCn: 该计划从制定之日起就注定要失败。

example: Milk the tea.
exampleCn: 把茶挤奶。

example: I do it for the fun of it.

exampleCn: 他不愿意让别人知道他的判断。

example: He could do many things if he pleased.
exampleCn: 只要他愿意，他可以做很多事情。

example: The news really surprised me.
exampleCn: 这个消息确实令我惊讶。

example: She grows fresh vegetables in her small garden behind the house every summer.
exampleCn: 她每年夏天都在房子后面的小园子里种新鲜蔬菜。

example: The palace issued an order binding on all subjects.
exampleCn: 宫殿发布了一项对所有主题都具有约束力的命令。

example: You find fast food stores everywhere.
exampleCn: 你随处可见快餐店。
